comment: M5-037: the vehicle turret mount source table. One row binds one turret mount to one vehicle: turret_weapon_id must reference an existing weapons row (a mount without a weapon is refused by the validator and the cross-table gate), location_cm is the turret pivot in centimeters relative to the vehicle origin, and the pitch clamp is in degrees with pitch_min_deg <= pitch_max_deg inside +/-89 (an inverted or unbounded clamp is an illegal pitch configuration).
